nights.title: Kid Kapichi
nights.name: Kid Kapichi
nights.extract: Kid Kapichi are an English punk rock band formed in Hastings in 2013. The band consists of vocalist and guitarist Jack Wilson and bassist Eddie Lewis.

en.who: Kid Kapichi are an English punk rock band formed in Hastings in 2013. Their line-up is built around vocalist and guitarist Jack Wilson and bassist Eddie Lewis.
facts: The band was formed in Hastings in 2013.
The band consists of vocalist and guitarist Jack Wilson and bassist Eddie Lewis.

de.who: Kid Kapichi sind eine englische Punkrockband, die 2013 in Hastings gegründet wurde. Die Besetzung um Sänger und Gitarrist Jack Wilson und Bassist Eddie Lewis bildet den Kern.
facts: Die Band wurde 2013 in Hastings gegründet.
Zur Band gehören Sänger und Gitarrist Jack Wilson sowie Bassist Eddie Lewis.

tr.who: Kid Kapichi, 2013'te Hastings'te kurulmuş bir İngiliz punk rock grubudur. Kadro, vokalist ve gitarist Jack Wilson ile basçı Eddie Lewis etrafında şekillenir.
facts: Grup, vokalist ve gitarist Jack Wilson ile basçı Eddie Lewis'ten oluşuyor.
